rules.label: Trial period cap
rules.summary: For an indefinite-term contract, the trial period (proeftijd) may not exceed two months. For a fixed-term contract of two years or more, the cap is also two months. Any longer trial period is void by operation of law.

rules.label: Non-compete clause must be in writing
rules.summary: A non-compete clause (concurrentiebeding) is only valid in an indefinite-term contract when agreed in writing with an adult employee. In a fixed-term contract it requires an additional written justification of compelling business interest. Verbal non-competes are unenforceable.
